content:
mira_ops: heads-up — saw a region-wide latency bump in us-west-2 this morning tied to a cold-start surge from prefill/warmup jobs. logs show multiple tenants kicking off big-model warms at once. any ideas? :wave:
ben_platform: saw it on TPS dashboard too. 99p latency jumped ~120ms -> ~540ms around 07:12 UTC.
lee_infra: quick data dump: prefill-rps spiked 3x, warm-slot-allocs ballooned and caused slab eviction churn. snippet:
```
[07:11:58] prefill_jobs=64 -> 192
[07:12:05] alloc_failures=12
[07:12:12] 99p_lat=540ms
```
ben_platform: are these warmups mostly Dedicated onboarding flows or random dev warmups?
mira_ops: majority are Dedicated onboarding + a couple of heavy dev teams. if we left everything pre-warming, rough cost is ~ $2k/day in us-west-2 for the slots we saw.
lee_infra: idea: introduce a "warmup credit shepherd" — small per-tenant daily budget of warmup credits per region/tier. when credits exhausted, warmups get queued or demoted behind lower-cost warm-pools. cheaper than blanket pre-warm.
ben_platform: like a token-bucket for warmups. sounds promising. need a routing constraint so critical SLO tenants can still get priority warms.
mira_ops: agree — priority override for enterprise SLOs + safety valve: allow 1 emergency warmup with audit log per tenant when credits are empty.
scheduler-bot: [automated] rollout plan: warmup-credit-shepherd v1 -> canary us-west-2 at 09:00 UTC, config preview: tier_dev:5, tier_prod:20 :gear:
lee_infra: ran a quick sim vs historical traffic — peak prefill reduced ~40%, cold-start spike frequency down ~18%. projected cost delta in us-west-2: -$1.1k/day.
ben_platform: ops questions: how do we avoid credit gaming (tenants alternating small warms)? tie credits to tenant id + cooldown + recent-success metric. also cap concurrent warms per tenant.
mira_ops: quick runbook draft:
```
- if warmup_credit > 0: allow warmup immediately
- else if tenant.slo == 'enterprise': allow up to 1 warmup/hour (override)
- else enqueue warmup to shared warm-pool (fifo)
- alert if queued_warmups > 50 for >5m
- emit audit event for every override
```
lee_infra: I can add a lightweight check in the prefill controller and a config flag for canary by EOD.
ben_platform: add a billback hook so Console shows tenants warmup usage + cost estimate. that'll discourage abuse.
mira_ops: agreed. let's run canary, watch 99p latency for 24h, then reconvene. thanks all :thumbsup:
ben_platform: +1
scheduler-bot: [deploy-bot] canary deploy succeeded in us-west-2 at 09:02 UTC — 2/2 instances healthy
mira_ops: closing loop — keep an eye on 99p for next 24h. if we still see spike clusters, we escalate to emergency reserve pool and temporary global throttle.
